configuration.title: DB Explorer Lite
configuration.properties.dbExplorer.prev: Initial rows per page in a table preview (can be changed in the preview, 1 to 1000).
configuration.properties.dbExplorer.maxR: Maximum number of rows kept and displayed for a query result (the rest is ignored).
configuration.properties.dbExplorer.show: Show system databases / schemas (information_schema, mysql, pg_catalog…).
configuration.properties.dbExplorer.csvS: Separator used for CSV export (“;” is often better for Excel in French locales).
configuration.properties.dbExplorer.conf: Ask for confirmation before running UPDATE / DELETE without WHERE, DROP, TRUNCATE or ALTER … DROP.
On a connection marked “production”, ask for confirmation before any write (SQL editor and grid).
configuration.properties.dbExplorer.prom: Ask for the value of named parameters (:name) before running a query. PostgreSQL “::”, strings and comments are ignored.
extension.description: Connect to MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL or SQLite, browse tables, view and export data, run SQL queries, show structure and the relationship diagram.
